endpoints.reach: Hills Access to River Junction Access
endpoints.coordinateEvidenceDetail: ia_johnson_county_river_junction_access_20260919 johnson-county-river-junction-official-map-coordinate: Johnson County Conservation's current camping record publishes River Junction map coordinates 41.4912969,-91.5017984 and states that the campground has boat-ramp access to the Iowa River. The county's River Junction Access & Campground PDF independently describes the 12-acre property, primitive campground, boat ramp, Iowa River Water Trail, and the 9.8-mile Hills-to-River-Junction segment. A current county closure notice reports River Junction Access closed until further notice because flooding at the Iowa/English River confluence affects access. Retain the exact county point as a documented access-area anchor, but preserve the current closure condition and do not treat it as an available launch until the county reopens it.
endpoints.note: Stored coordinate matches the named authoritative access-area control (ia_johnson_county_river_junction_access_20260919 johnson-county-river-junction-official-map-coordinate) on Iowa River; access is conditional (Johnson County currently reports River Junction Access closed until further notice due to flooding/confluence conditions; verify reopening, road/site status, parking, ramp, and water conditions before using this endpoint.), not unrestricted public access. This confirms the managed access area, not the exact water-edge point.

endpoints.reach: Hills Access to River Junction Access
endpoints.coordinateEvidenceDetail: ia_johnson_county_hills_access_campground_anchor_20260918 johnson-county-hills-access-official-map-coordinate: Johnson County Conservation's current camping record publishes Hills Access map coordinates 41.5544618,-91.5257829, exactly matching the two route endpoints, and states that the site has boat-ramp access to the Iowa River. Johnson County's public-use-area page identifies Hills Access as a 40-acre river-access park with a boat ramp; Iowa DNR's Iowa River Water Trail description identifies the cement boat ramp at Hills Access as a launch for the reach to River Junction. The official coordinate is the campground/site anchor, not a separately georeferenced ramp toe. Imagery places it at the 520th Street entrance/approach, with the ramp and shoreline displaced from that point; retain it as an access-site anchor and preserve the mapped-water offset for review.
endpoints.note: Stored coordinate matches the named authoritative access-area control (ia_johnson_county_hills_access_campground_anchor_20260918 johnson-county-hills-access-official-map-coordinate) on Iowa River; this confirms the public access site, not the exact water-edge point. Confirm the water-edge location and carry before paddling.
